summary: Layer 1B expands the public universe around AI data-center power availability away from the obvious chip/cloud names. The chokepoint hypothesis is that scarce powered land, utility interconnection capacity, substations, transmission upgrades, medium-voltage electrical gear, and skilled grid/electrical labor can become gating factors for AI data-center deployment. This pass keeps Quanta Services as the reference leader and adds underfollowed or less obvious US-listed contractors/equipment suppliers that sit one step closer to grid connection, substations, switchgear, power delivery, or large-load construction execution.
